evaluation_membership: analysis_split == evaluation and review_order between 201 and 400 inclusive
rationale: Apply the unchanged v1 adequacy minima to the enlarged protected reserve after the prespecified final 100 human reviews. The gate may emit only booleans, never outcome counts, rows, or examples.
failure_action: Do not authorize a new protected provider evaluation. Use development labels to improve the instrument, then propose a newly sampled independent evaluation design.
success_action: Use development labels only to freeze candidate prompts and scoring. Keep evaluation outcomes sealed until every authorized candidate output is complete.
